alternatives.option: Only reuse ids; leave finalize's rewrite untouched
alternatives.reason_rejected: Would still truncate repo_ids on a shared store — the same orphaning class the fix exists to close.

alternatives.option: Fix the layout heuristic in legacy-scan so migrated_from is stable at the source
alternatives.reason_rejected: Touches a different file and changes legacy/manifest.json's layouts across reruns; recorded as a need instead.

context: Implementation choices for the repo_ids fix: private declaredRepoId helper in v3-forward (no cross-layer import), finalize extends an existing store.json rather than replacing it, and the migrate cases live in a new single test file.
rationale: resolveIdentity now adopts the descriptor's ids, but the old finalize still wrote repo_ids: [repo_id] and created_at: state.started_at, which would drop a shared store's second checkout id and restamp the store's creation time. migrated_from is preserved because a rerun's legacy-scan sees records/RECORDS-FROZEN.md and reports v2, so the value flipped 1 -> 2 on every rerun (caught by the new byte-stability case, which failed pre-fix for that reason alone). All three are one read of the existing file, no new failure modes: an absent or malformed descriptor falls back to exactly the old values.
summary: Chose to have finalize EXTEND an existing store.json (repo_ids union with the migration's id first, created_at kept, migrated_from kept from the first run) instead of the previous full rewrite
